title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Nov 2026 data)
source: ISM: the October-data ISM Manufacturing report (PRNewswire 302925617, 'Manufacturing PMI® at 55.5%; October 2026 ISM® Manufacturing PMI® Report', issued 2026-11-02 10:00 ET) names its own successor verbatim — "The next ISM® Manufacturing PMI® Report featuring November 2026 data will be released at 10:00 a.m. ET on Tuesday, December 1, 2026." Read first-hand on prnewswire.com/news-releases/manufacturing-pmi-at-55-5-october-2026-ism-manufacturing-pmi-report-302925617.html by this event's own pulse 2026-11-09 (HTTP 200). Supersedes the prior EST: first-business-day derivation, which the wire sentence agrees with. ismworld.org's own ROB calendar remains SSO-gated and was not needed. Checked 2026-11-09
notes: Opens the December compound corridor: the first hard activity read of the month, three days ahead of jobs-2026-12-04 and eight ahead of the fomc-2026-12-09 SEP/dot-plot meeting. Prices-paid is the leg that matters into a hawkish regime — the 2026-09-01 edition printed activity cooling (54.6 vs 55.2 est, employment 51.2 vs 53.0 est) with Prices stuck at 71.1, the stagflation-shaped mix that makes a soft labor print un-buyable.
